account: Tata Elxsi proposes a system that synchronizes network information with models that recommend adjustments to resources and energy use. As of June 2025, the work consisted of prototypes demonstrated in simulated telecom environments. The company names better efficiency, lower costs, and reduced emissions as intended benefits. It reports no measured energy saving from any network, simulated or live. ITU republished the same text in its final report of October 2025. No later source reports results from the planned live operator pilots.
